about: What each snack looks like and how it is served, for the image prompts (doc 25.4). scripts/generate-images.mjs adds the house style. Every product is vegetarian.
style: Professional food photography, 45-degree angle, bright soft natural window light, warm cream background, realistic, appetising, sharp focus on the food, shallow depth of field, no text, no logos, no packaging print, no people, no hands

looks.adhirasam: Adhirasam from Tamil Nadu: five flat round dark-brown discs the size of a palm, glossy with ghee, porous jaggery and rice-flour texture, slightly raised puffed edges, stacked and overlapping on a polished brass plate
looks.aloo-tikki: Delhi aloo tikki chaat: two crisp golden round potato patties on a steel plate, topped with white yogurt, green mint chutney, brown tamarind chutney, red pomegranate seeds, chopped onion and fine yellow sev
looks.ariselu: Ariselu from Andhra Pradesh: flat round dark-brown rice and jaggery discs densely coated with white sesame seeds, glossy, stacked on a banana leaf on a brass plate
looks.bakarwadi: Bakarwadi from Pune: a heap of small bite-sized golden-brown crispy pinwheel rolls, each showing a tight spiral of spiced coconut and sesame filling, in a shallow ceramic bowl
looks.batata-vada: Maharashtrian batata vada: four round deep-fried potato dumplings in a craggy crisp golden gram-flour batter, one broken open to show yellow spiced potato inside, fried green chillies and green chutney on a steel plate
looks.bobbatlu: Bobbatlu from Andhra Pradesh: three thin soft golden flatbreads with brown blistered spots, brushed with ghee so they glisten, one folded and torn to show a smooth bright yellow paste of chana dal and jaggery inside, on a brass plate, no eggs
looks.bonda: Andhra bonda: six round golden deep-fried batter balls with slightly cracked crisp surface, one broken open to show fluffy inside, a small bowl of white coconut chutney, on a steel plate
looks.chekkalu: Chekkalu from Andhra Pradesh: thin flat round deep-fried rice crackers, crunchy and golden brown with a blistered crisp surface, speckled with chana dal, green curry leaves and red chilli flecks, stacked in a wicker basket
looks.chikki: Maharashtrian peanut chikki: rectangular bars of roasted peanuts set in glossy amber jaggery brittle, stacked on parchment on a wooden board
looks.dhokla: Gujarati khaman dhokla: soft spongy bright yellow squares topped with black mustard seeds, green chillies, curry leaves, grated coconut and chopped coriander, on a white ceramic plate
looks.dilkush: Hyderabadi bakery dilkush: a round golden-brown baked sweet bread cut into wedges, the cut side showing a filling of grated coconut and red and green tutti frutti, on a white plate
looks.ghewar: Rajasthani ghewar: one large round disc-shaped fried sweet with a lacy honeycomb texture, soaked in syrup, topped with a layer of malai cream, chopped pistachios, almonds and silver leaf, on a brass plate
looks.irani-samosa: Hyderabadi Irani cafe samosas: small flat crisp triangular samosas with thin flaky pale golden pastry, served on a small white saucer with a glass cup of milky tea behind
looks.jhal-muri: Kolkata jhal muri: puffed rice tossed with chopped onion, tomato, green chilli, coriander, roasted peanuts and a coconut slice, served in a plain brown paper cone on a wooden table
looks.kachori: Delhi khasta kachori: three round puffed golden flaky kachoris, one broken open to show spiced lentil filling, with tamarind chutney in a small bowl, on a steel plate
looks.kaja: Kakinada kaja from Andhra Pradesh: glossy golden elongated layered fried pastries soaked in sugar syrup, juicy and shining, arranged in a row on a brass plate
looks.kathi-roll: Kolkata paneer kathi roll: a flaky paratha rolled around chargrilled paneer tikka, sliced onions and green chillies, wrapped at the bottom in plain white paper, cut in half to show the filling, on a wooden board
looks.khandvi: Gujarati khandvi: bite-sized soft pale yellow gram-flour rolls arranged in rows, topped with tempered mustard seeds, sesame seeds, grated coconut and coriander, on a white ceramic plate
looks.khari-biscuit: Khari biscuits: flaky golden rectangular puff pastry biscuits with many crisp layers visible, stacked, beside a small cup of chai, on a wooden table
looks.kodubale: Karnataka kodubale: a pile of crunchy ring-shaped deep-fried rice-flour snacks, reddish golden with a rough texture, in a dark ceramic bowl
looks.luqmi: Hyderabadi luqmi: square flaky golden pastry pockets with crimped edges, one cut open to show a spiced vegetable filling, on a white plate
looks.maddur-vada: Maddur vada from Karnataka: flat round crisp golden-brown fritters with visible onion, semolina and curry leaves, served with coconut chutney on a banana leaf
looks.mawa-kachori: Jodhpur mawa kachori: round fried pastries glazed in shiny sugar syrup, topped with pistachio slivers, one broken to show a creamy mawa and dry fruit filling, on a brass plate
looks.medu-vada: Medu vada: four crisp golden doughnut-shaped urad dal fritters with a hole in the centre, served with coconut chutney and a small bowl of sambar on a banana leaf
looks.mirchi-bajji: Guntur mirchi bajji: long whole green chillies coated in gram-flour batter and deep-fried golden, slit open and stuffed with chopped raw onion and coriander, on a steel plate
looks.mirchi-vada: Jodhpur mirchi vada: thick large green chillies stuffed with spiced potato, coated in batter and deep-fried golden, one cut across to show the yellow potato filling, on a steel plate
looks.misal-pav: Maharashtrian misal pav: a bowl of spicy red sprouted moth bean curry topped with crunchy farsan, chopped onion and coriander, a lemon wedge, and two soft pav buns beside it on a steel plate
looks.mysore-pak: Mysore pak from Karnataka: golden yellow square pieces of ghee and gram-flour fudge with a porous honeycomb texture, neatly stacked on a brass plate
looks.nippattu: Nippattu from Karnataka: thick flat round crisp rice crackers studded with peanuts, chana dal and curry leaves, golden brown, stacked on a woven plate
looks.osmania-biscuit: Hyderabadi Osmania biscuits: round pale golden buttery cookies with lightly cracked tops, stacked, beside a cup of Irani chai on a saucer
looks.pootharekulu: Pootharekulu from Atreyapuram, Andhra Pradesh: rectangular rolls made of paper-thin translucent white rice starch sheets folded with jaggery powder and ghee, layered like tissue paper, arranged on a brass plate
looks.punugulu: Andhra punugulu: a heap of small irregular round crisp golden fried batter balls, served with red peanut chutney in a small bowl on a steel plate
looks.puran-poli: Maharashtrian puran poli: soft golden flatbreads stuffed with yellow chana dal and jaggery, folded into quarters, a spoon of ghee on top, on a white plate
looks.pyaaz-kachori: Jodhpur pyaaz kachori: two large round golden flaky kachoris, one broken open to show a spiced onion filling, with green and tamarind chutneys, on a steel plate
looks.rosogolla: Bengali rosogolla: soft white spongy round cottage-cheese balls floating in clear sugar syrup in a small terracotta clay bowl
looks.sabudana-vada: Sabudana vada: round flattened golden-crisp patties with visible white tapioca pearls and crushed peanuts, served with green chutney and yogurt on a white plate
looks.sandesh: Bengali sandesh: delicate pale cream soft sweets pressed into shell and flower shapes, topped with saffron strands and pistachio, arranged on a white plate
looks.seedai: Tamil Nadu seedai: a pile of small marble-sized crunchy deep-fried rice-flour balls, golden brown, in a brass bowl
looks.sohan-halwa: Delhi sohan halwa: dense square pieces of caramel-brown halwa glistening with ghee, studded with almonds and pistachios, on a brass plate
looks.sundal: Tamil Nadu sundal: boiled chickpeas tempered with mustard seeds, curry leaves, dried red chilli and grated coconut, in a small cup made of a dried leaf
looks.sunnundalu: Andhra sunnundalu: round matte brown urad dal and jaggery laddus with a coarse texture, stacked in a small pyramid on a brass plate
looks.thepla: Gujarati methi thepla: thin round flatbreads flecked with green fenugreek leaves and spices, stacked and folded, with mango pickle and yogurt in small bowls, on a wooden board
looks.vada-pav: Mumbai vada pav: a golden fried potato vada inside a soft split pav bun with green chutney and red dry garlic chutney, a fried green chilli beside it, on a steel plate
